Evaluating Protocols and Standards for Forest Carbon-Offset Programs, Part B: Leakage Assessment, Wood Products, Validation and Verification
abstract: In the second and final part of this series, we review ten prominent standards and protocols for how they address three key issues – leakage, wood products and validation/verification. On all of these dimensions and across all programs we find problems that call into question the credibility of the programs’ certified projects and offset credits. The problems are compounded by the issues raised in the companion article (Part A), which examines additionality, baselines and permanence. The pervasive nature of the flaws raises the question of the feasibility of designing a forest carbon-offset protocol that provides both reasonable credibility and low transactions costs. We suggest some possible approaches to forest carbon-offset protocols and their alternatives.
abstract_zh: 在本系列的第二篇也是最后一篇中，我们审视了十项知名标准和协议在三个关键问题上的处理方式：泄漏、木质产品以及核证与核查。在所有这些维度上、所有项目中，我们都发现了问题，这些问题使人对项目认证的项目及碳抵消信用的可信度产生质疑。这些问题与配套文章（A部分）所讨论的问题相叠加，后者考察了额外性、基准线和持久性。这些缺陷的普遍性引发了一个问题：能否设计出既具有合理可信度又能保持较低交易成本的森林碳抵消协议。我们提出了森林碳抵消协议及其替代方案的一些可能途径。

title: REDD, PINC and Other Shades of Green: Institutional Requirements for an International Forest Carbon Sequestration Treaty in a Post-Kyoto World
Determinants of the Costs of Carbon Capture and Sequestration for Expanding Electricity Generation Capacity
abstract: The carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) literature to date lacks a comprehensive economic analysis. Our study addresses this need. It models the costs of the entire process, from generation at the power plant to carbon injection at the reservoir, examining the economic factors that affect technology choice and CCS costs. We consider three major fossil fuel generating technologies, each with and without CCS. Our results suggest that natural gas and coal prices have profound impacts on the carbon price needed to induce CCS. Previous cost modeling approaches do not capture this complexity. Therefore, we developed a cost region graph that models technology choice as a function of carbon and fuel prices. Generally, the least‐cost technology at low carbon prices is pulverized coal, while intermediate carbon prices favor natural gas technologies and high carbon prices favor coal gasification with capture. However, the specific carbon prices at which these transitions occur is largely determined by the price of natural gas. For instance, the CCS-justifying carbon price ranges from $100/t C at high natural gas prices to $200/t C at low natural gas prices. This result has important implications for potential climate change legislation. Additionally, our analysis informs the relative importance of other variables. Capital costs are highly important, as reflected by the impact of the Energy Policy Act of 2005, which substantially lowers the justifying carbon price and favors coal technologies. Pipeline distance and reservoir type have smaller impacts overall, but highlight the heterogeneity of costs across industry.
abstract_zh: 迄今为止，碳捕集与封存（CCS）文献缺乏全面的经济分析。本研究填补了这一空白。我们对整个流程的成本进行了建模，从发电厂发电到将碳注入储层，并考察了影响技术选择和CCS成本的经济因素。我们考虑了三种主要的化石燃料发电技术，每种技术均分为有CCS和无CCS两种情形。我们的结果表明，天然气和煤炭价格对诱导采用CCS所需的碳价格有着深远影响。以往的成本建模方法未能捕捉这种复杂性。因此，我们开发了一个成本区域图，将技术选择建模为碳价格和燃料价格的函数。总体而言，在低碳价格下，成本最低的技术是粉煤发电；中等碳价格有利于天然气技术；而高碳价格则有利于带捕集的煤气化技术。然而，这些转换发生时的具体碳价格，在很大程度上取决于天然气价格。例如，使CCS具备经济合理性的碳价格，在高天然气价格下约为每吨碳100美元，而在低天然气价格下则约为每吨碳200美元。这一结果对潜在的气候变化立法具有重要意义。此外，我们的分析还揭示了其他变量的相对重要性。资本成本极为重要，《2005年能源政策法》的影响即是例证，该法案大幅降低了使CCS具备合理性的碳价格，并有利于煤炭技术。管道距离和储层类型的影响总体较小，但凸显了产业内成本的异质性。

title: The National Inventory Approach for International Forest Carbon Sequestration Management
venue: The Economics and Politics of Climate Change
abstract: This chapter describes a national inventory (NI) approach for the management of forest carbon sequestration and the major challenges that individual countries would face under an NI regime. It first considers how the NI approach differs from prevailing approaches before presenting examples of national data on forests and forest carbon for ten different countries. It then examines the implications of country-specific circumstances and how those might affect both the direction of the negotiations that are at the base of the NI approach and the design of the programme itself. It also explains how Brazil might approach the negotiation process and concludes by suggesting that the national inventory approach provides a promising model for a future international agreement.
abstract_zh: 本章描述了一种用于管理森林碳汇的国家清单（NI）方法，以及各国在国家清单机制下将面临的主要挑战。本章首先考察了国家清单方法与现行方法的差异，随后列举了十个国家的森林及森林碳的国家数据示例。接着，本章分析了各国具体情况的影响，以及这些情况可能如何影响国家清单方法谈判的走向及项目本身的设计。本章还阐述了巴西如何应对谈判进程，并总结认为，国家清单方法为未来的国际协定提供了一个有前景的模式。

title: The U.S. Forest Service and Its Responsibilities under the National Environmental Policy Act: A Work Design Problem
Comparative Analysis of Climate Change Bills in the U.S. Senate
International Forest Carbon Sequestration in a Post-Kyoto Agreement
abstract: Introduction Forest carbon management must be an important element of any international agreement on climate change. Forest carbon flows comprise a significant part of overall global greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. While global forests as a whole may be a net sink (Nabours and Masera 2007), global emissions from deforestation contribute between 20 and 25 percent of all GHG emissions (Sedjo and Sohngen 2007, Skutsch et al . 2007). The size of the total global carbon pool in forest vegetation has been estimated at 359 gigatonnes of carbon (GtC), which compares to annual global carbon emissions from industrial sources of approximately 6.3 GtC (IPCC 2000). The potential impact on the global carbon cycle of both natural and anthropogenic changes in forests is enormous. An effective international forest carbon management regime must not only provide landowners and governments with incentives to protect and expand stocks of carbon, but must induce countries to enroll in the forest agreement in the first place. Ideally, a multilateral forest carbon program would also impose relatively low transaction costs even as it encourages decision makers to seek low-cost opportunities for sequestration. The current international regime, the Kyoto Protocol, has proven ineffective in this regard. There are three primary problems. First, the Annex I (industrialized) countries are required to include afforestation, reforestation, and deforestation in their national accounting. However, Article 3.3 of the Kyoto Protocol limits that accounting to changes that are “human-induced,” inviting endless arguments about which changes should be included. For example, one can make reasonable arguments both for and against, say, Canada's inclusion of continued northern forest growth as a “human-induced” change in its national carbon account.
abstract_zh: 引言 森林碳管理必须是任何国际气候协定的重要组成部分。森林碳流动在全球温室气体（GHG）排放中占有相当大的比重。尽管全球森林整体可能是净汇（Nabours and Masera 2007），但来自毁林的全球排放量占所有温室气体排放的20%至25%（Sedjo and Sohngen 2007；Skutsch et al. 2007）。全球森林植被碳库的规模估计为3590亿吨碳（GtC），而工业来源的年度全球碳排放量约为6.3 GtC（IPCC 2000）。森林自然及人为变化对全球碳循环的潜在影响是巨大的。一项有效的国际森林碳管理机制，不仅必须为土地所有者和政府提供激励，以保护和扩大碳储量，还必须促使各国首先加入森林协定。理想情况下，多边森林碳项目还应在鼓励决策者寻求低成本固碳机会的同时，保持相对较低的交易成本。当前的国际机制《京都议定书》在这方面已被证明是无效的。主要存在三个问题。第一，附件一（工业化）国家被要求将造林、再造林和毁林纳入其国家核算。然而，《京都议定书》第3.3条将该核算限制在“人为引起”的变化上，从而引发了关于应包括哪些变化的无休止争论。例如，对于加拿大将北部森林的持续生长作为“人为引起”的变化纳入其国家碳账户，既可以提出合理的赞成理由，也可以提出合理的反对理由。

Environmental Taxes in the United States
venue: Critical Issues in International Environmental Taxation
abstract: Environmental taxes can be powerful and economically effi cient policy tools for protecting the environment.1 It is often asserted, however, that in choosing among incentive-based environmental policy instruments, the USA favours marketable allowances while Europe favours taxes.2 This may be true, but it is also a bit misleading if it is taken to suggest that the USA does not employ environmental taxes at all. In fact, the USA has applied environmental taxes in many areas, including transportation, hazardous and solid waste, and water protection. Moreover, all levels of government—federal, state and local—have employed taxes that directly or indirectly protect the environment.
abstract_zh: 环境税可以成为强有力且经济效率高的政策工具，用于保护环境。¹ 人们常常断言，在选择基于激励的环境政策工具时，美国偏好可交易许可，而欧洲偏好税收。²这种说法也许属实，但如果据此认为美国根本不采用环境税，则有些误导。事实上，美国已在交通、危险和固体废物以及水污染防治等诸多领域应用了环境税。此外，各级政府（联邦、州和地方）都曾采用直接或间接保护环境的税收。

Framing Environmental Policy Instrument Choice
venue: Duke Environmental Law and Policy Forum
abstract: This paper helps clarify the relation among the many policy instruments that the government uses when transaction costs limit the applicability of the Coase Theorem. This is accomplished by synthesizing results from the environmental economics, new institutional economics, and public economics literatures into a new conceptual framework and taxonomy of environmental policy instruments. Three primary conclusions emerge. First, the taxonomy of policy instruments frequently described in the environmental economics literature needs to be expanded to recognize that the government can operate in either a coersive (regulatory and taxing) mode or an enterprise mode (subsidies, contracts and government production). Second, the typical characterization of coersive policy instruments as command and control versus taxes/marketable allowances is a false dichotomy. Third, choosing the most cost-effective instruments requires expanding the analysis beyond the typical focus on production costs to include implementation costs and public finance costs. This is accomplished by recasting the evaluation criteria that are typically used in comparative analysis of policy instruments as a constrained cost minimization problem. The paper concludes with a set of heuristic principles indicating which factors raise the relative attrativeness of the various instruments. The result demonstrates that in environmental policy instrument choice, one size does not fit all.
abstract_zh: 本文有助于厘清当交易成本限制了科斯定理的适用性时，政府所使用的众多政策工具之间的关系。为此，本文将环境经济学、新制度经济学和公共经济学的文献成果加以综合，形成了一个新的概念框架和环境政策工具分类体系。得出三个主要结论。第一，环境经济学文献中常见的政策工具分类需要加以扩展，以认识到政府既可以以强制性方式（监管和征税）运作，也可以以企业性方式（补贴、合同和政府生产）运作。第二，将强制性政策工具典型地归为命令控制型与税收/可交易许可型两类，是一种错误的二分法。第三，选择成本最有效的工具，需要将分析范围从通常关注的生产成本扩展到包括执行成本和公共财政成本。这是通过将比较分析政策工具时通常使用的评价标准重新表述为约束成本最小化问题来实现的。本文最后提出了一套启发式原则，指出哪些因素会提高各类工具的相对吸引力。研究结果表明，在环境政策工具选择上，没有放之四海而皆准的方案。

title: Institutional Frameworks for Political Action
Coercion and Enterprise in the Provision of Environmental Public Goods: The Case of Carbon Sequestration in the United States
venue: Critical Reviews in Environmental Science and Technology
abstract: Current discussions of greenhouse gas abatement strategies have focussed on the use of carbon taxes and marketable allowance schemes. Implementation of a large-scale carbon sequestration program in the United States will require broadening the scope of the instruments under consideration to include contracts, subsidies, command and control regulation and direct government production. This paper develops a taxonomy for these instruments, examines the factors that affect their relative attractiveness, and applies that analysis to carbon sequestration in the United States.
abstract_zh: 当前关于温室气体减排战略的讨论，主要集中于碳税和可交易许可制度。要在美国实施大规模的碳封存项目，就需要拓宽所考虑工具的范围，将合同、补贴、命令控制型监管以及政府直接生产纳入其中。本文建立了这些工具的分类体系，考察了影响其相对吸引力的因素，并将该分析应用于美国的碳封存。

title: Consideration of Country and Forestry/Land-Use Characteristics in Choosing Forestry Instruments to Achieve Climate Mitigation Goals
venue: Critical Reviews in Environmental Science and Technology
abstract: To implement effective carbon sequestration policies policymakers must analyze key characteristics of the country (geographic, institutional, economic, and infrastructural factors) and forestry and land-use practices (the degree of risk associated with investment, the relative difficulty in measuring sequestration, and the degree of discretion allowed). Without careful analysis of this type, policies may have unintended negative effects.
abstract_zh: 为有效实施碳封存政策，决策者必须分析国家的关键特征（地理、制度、经济和基础设施因素）以及林业和土地利用实践（投资相关的风险程度、封存量测量的相对难度，以及允许的自由裁量程度）。如果缺乏这类细致分析，政策可能产生意想不到的负面效应。

title: The Time Value of Carbon in Bottom-up Studies
venue: Critical Reviews in Environmental Science and Technology
abstract: In many climate change mitigation cost-effectiveness studies that do not develop endogenous shadow prices for the value of carbon it is necessary to determine the time value of reductions in carbon dioxide emissions. This paper examines the implications for the time value of carbon of exogenously specifying (1) the path of marginal damages over time, (2) the path of emissions over time, and (3) that the emissions path follow an optimal trajectory over time.
abstract_zh: 在许多不发展影子价格内生模型来确定碳价值的气候变化减排成本效益研究中，有必要确定二氧化碳减排的时间价值。本文考察了外生设定以下三项假设对碳时间价值的影响：（1）边际损害随时间的路径，（2）排放量随时间的路径，以及（3）排放路径遵循随时间推移的最优轨迹。

title: Climate Change Damage and the Trace Gas Index Issue
abstract: The Environmental Protection Agency report illustrated that if serious efforts were undertaken to limit climate change as induced by human activity, the efforts could not be limited to CO 2 alone. Scientists working on the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change Scientific Assessment of Climate Change offered significant refinements to the index by improving the representation of physical processes. This chapter examines the relevant index should be an index of economic effect of climate-environmental change, which requires adjustments to simple measures of radiative forcing because the gases are removed from the atmosphere at different rates and marginal damages are likely to vary over time. Climate-related resources are determined by the aggregate concentration of trace gases. In particular, effort is required to characterize the economic damage associated with climate and the direct effects of trace-gas accumulation. A popular notion is that the best response to climate change is to pursue policies that would make sense to pursue even without climate change.
abstract_zh: 美国环境保护署的报告表明，如果为限制人类活动引起的气候变化而做出认真努力，这些努力就不能仅限于二氧化碳。参与政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）科学评估的科学家通过改进对物理过程的表征，对该指数提出了重要的修正意见。本章考察了相关指数应当是气候环境变化的经济效应指数，这需要对简单的辐射强迫指标进行调整，因为各类气体从大气中被清除的速率不同，且边际损害可能随时间变化。气候相关资源由痕量气体的总体浓度决定。特别是，需要对与气候相关的经济损害，以及痕量气体累积的直接效应进行刻画。一种流行的观点认为，应对气候变化的最佳对策，是采取即使在没有气候变化的情况下也值得实行的政策。

title: Costs of Creation of Carbon Sinks in the U.S.
Stabilizing U.S. Net Carbon Emissions by Planting Trees
Policy and Research Implications of Recent Carbon Sequestering Analysis
venue: Economic Issues in Global Climate Change
abstract: This chapter describes the results of the study and some of the implications for policy. It explores some of the questions about implementation that the study raises. To test the magnitude of the uncertainty in the model, the chapter discusses the results of some simple sensitivity analyses. It outlines the importance of the shape of the forestry growth curve and its relation to dynamic analysis and policy formulation. The purpose of the research on carbon sequestering was to develop a range of least-cost estimates for carbon sequestration as expressed in marginal and total cost curves. These estimates would allow preliminary comparison with least-cost estimates for alternative technologies that could reduce net carbon emissions. The estimates of increases in carbon-sequestration rates through improved practices on forestlands of low productivity are obviously based on the difference between two factors: the rate of net carbon uptake after treatment and the rate of sequestration in the absence of treatment.
abstract_zh: 本章介绍了研究结果以及对政策的一些启示，并探讨了该研究引出的若干实施层面的问题。为检验模型中不确定性的大小，本章讨论了若干简单敏感性分析的结果。本章还阐明了林业生长曲线形态的重要性，及其与动态分析和政策制定之间的关系。碳封存研究的目的，是以边际成本曲线和总成本曲线的形式，给出一系列碳封存的最低成本估计。这些估计将使我们能够与可减少净碳排放的其他技术的最低成本估计进行初步比较。通过改善低生产力林地的经营方式而提高碳封存速率的估计，显然取决于两个因素之差：处理之后的净碳吸收速率，与未经处理情形下的碳封存速率。
